title: The Verifiability Gateway: A Governance Agent's Discovery of SAI Non-Identifiability

contributions.purpose: 把气候条约验证重构为系统辨识问题(Verifiability Gateway原则)
contributions.mechanism: 跨域KG结构缺口检测:高betweenness节点跨域连通≈0触发桥接假设
contributions.evaluation: 定性发现;gap score 0.86(阈0.3),betweenness 0.82/0.79、跨域边权0.03
contributions.source_quote: the agent's analysis discovered that the foundational premise of continuous SAI governance is mathematically unsound, as it violates the Principle of Persistent Excitation.

contributions.purpose: 实证连续vs脉冲强迫的参数可恢复性差距
contributions.mechanism: 简化能量平衡模型系统辨识+8个GeoMIP模型功率谱
contributions.evaluation: 连续强迫参数误差>1500%(γ²≈0不可恢复),脉冲<5%(γ²=0.58),17.3±2.1×可验证性差距(8模型95%CI)
contributions.source_quote: continuous forcing renders system parameters unrecoverable (>1500% error) while dynamic forcing enables precise recovery (<5% error), with a 17.3±2.1× verifiability gap (95% CI across 8 models).

contributions.purpose: 提出NVE诊断框架及AI驱动约束发现方法
contributions.mechanism: 利用ENSO自然变率制造持续激励信号+结构缺口检测/桥接假设算法
contributions.evaluation: 声称5×-20×信号优势(称实测23×改进)
contributions.source_quote: the agent proposed the Natural Variability Exploitation (NVE) framework, a protocol that uses time-varying forcing not as a climate controller, but as a planetary-scale diagnostic instrument to make the climate system mathematically 'legible' for treaty verification.

self_declared_provenance.quote: The Verifiability Gateway thus represents a prerequisite to traditional D&A—without persistent excitation, there is no recoverable fingerprint to detect.

notes: 属自引'Trilogy of Constraints'三部曲之一(与AS0331/AS0332互引,References署名'Anonymous/AIXC' companion works,协同自引环,疑破坏双盲)。整篇即负结果(连续SAI数学不可验证),但本质同义反复:连续DC输入不满足persistent excitation本是控制论已知结论,包装成'革命性发现'=循环自证。数据红旗:多处幻影/破碎交叉引用'(??)'、'Table??'、companion cite '?';正文'The greater than 1500'句被截断;两处模型清单不一致(正文含HadGEM2-ES/GFDL-ESM2G/CanESM2,附录Table5列GFDL-CM4/HadGEM3-GC31/UKESM1-0-LL=表格疑造);观测γ²=0.58自认'低于95%显著阈值0.76'却在Table5全标Detection:Yes(自相矛盾);Autonomy Metrics表(2547决策/847模式/0人工干预/12436节点/37缺口/8假设/72h)为可疑自证自主性指标。责任声明误引'NeurIPS Code of Ethics'。trade-off:Table3 Master Comparative(可验证性vs强迫平稳性:脉冲=Termination-by-Choice,连续=Termination-by-Collapse)。
